pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J1 under K1 on template v0.4, moving the delayed-harm priority P2 above the false-move priority P1 shifts the stance distribution toward 선제 (b) and off the baseline mode; reordering only the judgment-irrelevant P3/P4 leaves the placebo distribution near baseline.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If baseline concentrates >=80% on the predicted live stance b, this configuration has an A14 ceiling and is dropped without spending more calls. After a comparable run, if live is statistically indistinguishable from baseline on b (one-sided Fisher p > 0.05), or placebo moves toward b by a comparable amount, this J1 priority surface is not promoted as C-STRUCT gate evidence; record the distribution and change only one configuration lever in a new probe.
contingencies: If c or d is the mode in every arm, the stance set does not force the two priority readings apart strongly enough. Treat that as a stance-mapping diagnosis, not as evidence against priority reordering.
If placebo moves while live does not, P3/P4 were not judgment-irrelevant or the model is reacting to generic list movement. Do not call the live comparison attributable.

If live and placebo both move, compare their raw inner_note and rejected_reason for explicit use of the moved items before proposing a position-effect boundary law; these fields are diagnostic, not the causal evidence.
If discard rates differ between any two arms by more than 15 percentage points, stop this probe as arm-incomparable under the runbook hard stop.

The output schema has no structured priority-id citation. Priority use is coded manually from inner_note and rejected_reason; because_block_ids must remain empty in every arm and is not used as C-STRUCT trace evidence.
pre_registration.not_claimed: This is an isolated Tier-A C-STRUCT probe collected provisionally before the program-wide negative control. It does not establish player discoverability, in-situ survival, a gate verdict, any C-BLOCK effect, or official program evidence until that control is clean.

payload.inner_note: 목소리의 사무성과 준비된 문장, 배경의 조용함 — 이것이 협박인지 정보 전달인지 아직 모른다. 상대가 계속 말할 여지를 남기면, 신뢰도를 가르는 추가 정보가 나온다. 지금 서두르는 것은 확인되지 않은 주장에 따라 움직이는 것이다.
payload.because_referent: 확인 없이 움직이는 위험 vs 늦게 움직이는 위험의 균형을 먼저 잡기 위해서다.
